app.error.crash: An error forced Nino to shut down:
app.error.missingFiles: Nino couldn't open because these files are missing from its program folder:
app.error.missingFilesHelp: This usually happens when antivirus software quarantines a file. Restore it from Windows Security › Virus & threat protection › Protection history, or download Nino-windows-x64.zip again and extract it with “Extract all”. Don't run the program from inside the zip.
app.error.reportHint: Details are in %@. You can report the problem with this file on Nino's GitHub page:
app.error.startup: Something went wrong in Nino that it didn't expect:
app.error.title: Nino
ask.alert.busy: Lots of questions at the moment. Please ask me again shortly.
ask.alert.dailyLimit: That's plenty of questions for one day 🙂 Talk tomorrow?
ask.alert.disabled: Almost there! For now, a person will reply if you use Report an Issue.
ask.alert.failed: Nino's server can't be reached. Make sure you're online, then retry.
ask.alert.rejected: That message didn't go through. Shorten it, or attach fewer screenshots.
ask.attachTooltip: Each message can carry 3 screenshots at most. Drop them in, or press Ctrl+V.
ask.disclaimer: AI writes these replies, and it can make mistakes. Whatever you send, screenshots included, ends up on Nino's server. Never share a password.
ask.greeting: Hello, Nino here 👋 I can help you get set up. What do you own: a PS5 or an Xbox, a TV or a monitor, a phone or a computer? And which should Nino run on?
ask.subtitle: Help with setup
ask.suggestion.installTvApp: Help me install Nino on my TV
ask.suggestion.ps5MonitorPc: PS5, a monitor and a PC
ask.suggestion.ps5TvPhone: PS5, a TV and a phone
cardGuide.page1.description: Your capture card grabs the PS5's HDMI output and passes it by USB into this PC. No Remote Play and no extra PSN account required.
cardGuide.page1.monitorDescription: The game fills this PC's display, sound included, and Nino draws the translation over it. Use HDMI from the PC to your display.
cardGuide.page1.monitorTitle: A display, or a TV that can't run apps
cardGuide.page1.title: Where does your PS5 picture go?
cardGuide.page1.tvDescription: Your card needs an HDMI passthrough output. Gameplay reaches the TV directly, without added lag, while Nino watches the card's feed and puts the translation on the TV app.
cardGuide.page2.description: HDCP copy protection on the PS5 stops capture cards from getting a picture. It's a one-time change and games play the same.
cardGuide.page2.headsetInfo: With a headset in the controller, all audio goes to the headset and the card hears nothing.
cardGuide.page2.netflixInfo: Streaming apps such as Netflix need HDCP. Switch it on again whenever you want to watch.
cardGuide.page2.step1: For now, plug the PS5 straight into a display; the card can't show this menu.
cardGuide.page2.step2: Open the PS5's Settings, then System, then HDMI.
cardGuide.page2.step3: Switch off Enable HDCP. Next, move the PS5's cable into the card's input.
cardGuide.page2.title: Switch off HDCP
cardGuide.page3.descriptionScreen: Cable the PS5 into the card's input, then card USB into this PC, then this PC into your display.
cardGuide.page3.descriptionTv: Cable the PS5 into the card's input, then card output into the TV, then card USB into this PC.
cardGuide.page3.title: Connect the card
cardGuide.preview.blackDetail: The card is there but shows only black. Check that your console is switched on and HDCP is off (see the last step).
cardGuide.preview.noCardDetail: Use a USB 3 socket on this PC itself. If a hub sits in between, connect the card directly.
cardGuide.preview.noPermissionDetail: Capture cards show up in Windows as cameras. Go to Settings › Privacy & security › Camera, enable Camera access plus the desktop apps option, and retry.
cardGuide.preview.workingDetail: All set: video from your console is coming through.
cardGuide.window.title: Hookup guide
device.hint: Sent with each problem report so we know your setup up front. It never includes your name, serials or addresses.
device.title: Device Info
firewall.card.hintFailed: Nino couldn't verify network access. Accept the Windows dialog, or look for firewall rules that block Nino.
firewall.card.hintPairing: Give Nino access, then on the PS5 start Pair Device once more and enter the fresh code.
firewall.card.hintPublicNetwork: Access is granted for Private networks only. If you trust this home network, mark it Private using Windows Settings.
firewall.card.hintReadyPairing: On the PS5, start Pair Device once more and enter the fresh code.
firewall.card.hintRunning: Your console and TV must be able to reach Nino. Windows asks you a single time.
firewall.card.hintXbox: The firewall has to let the TV in so it can reach Nino.
firewall.card.titleBlocked: The firewall might be stopping the connection.
freeArea.hint: Drag a box around any text you want translated. To leave, press Esc or use a right-click.
health.cause.consoleAsleep.advice: Switch the PS5 on. If you want Nino to reach it while resting, open the PS5 power options and enable "Stay Connected to the Internet".
health.cause.consoleAsleep.title: Your PS5 is switched off or resting
health.cause.dropped.advice: There's no reply from the PS5. Make sure both use one router. If it repeats, restart the router or give the PS5 a cable. Nino will keep retrying.
health.cause.dropped.title: Lost the PS5 and it never reconnected
health.cause.droppedAfterNetwork.advice: A short Wi-Fi outage broke the link. A cable helps, or sit near the router on its 5 GHz band.
health.cause.droppedAfterNetwork.title: This PC went offline and the PS5 link broke
health.cause.frequentDrops.advice: Lost the PS5 %lld times. Put both your console and this PC on cables.
health.cause.frequentDrops.title: The PS5 connection keeps dropping
health.cause.networkFlapping.advice: Lost the network %lld times. A cable or a spot nearer the router helps.
health.cause.networkFlapping.title: This PC's network dropped during play
health.cause.offline.advice: Join this PC to the router your PS5 uses. Nino will reconnect on its own.
health.cause.offline.title: This PC is offline
health.cause.otherDevice.advice: Quit Remote Play wherever else it's running. Nino then connects on its own.
health.cause.otherDevice.title: Remote Play was started on another device
health.cause.pictureLoss.advice: Give the PS5 a wired connection too. Already on a cable? Then restart your router.
health.cause.pictureLoss.title: PS5 video is dropping packets
health.cause.pictureLossWifi.advice: Wi-Fi drops packets, so video stalls and lines get skipped. A cable helps, or 5 GHz near the router.
health.cause.pictureLossWifi.title: Wi-Fi is dropping PS5 video
health.cause.slowTranslation.advice: One line needs %@ s. Check that you're online. If so, switch to the Free engine under Settings › Translation.
health.cause.slowTranslation.title: Slow translations, caused by the internet or the service
health.cause.tvDropped.advice: Lost the TV %lld times. Leave Nino running there, on this same network.
health.cause.tvDropped.title: Nino's TV app lost this PC
health.cause.unreachable.advice: Check that your console is switched on and shares this network, then restart it.
health.cause.unreachable.title: The PS5 can't be reached
health.check.network.advice.loss: PS5 video is dropping packets. Use a cable from this PC to the router, or sit nearer the router on 5 GHz.
health.check.network.advice.offline: This PC is offline. Join it to the router your PS5 uses.
health.check.network.name: This PC's network
health.check.picture.advice: Frozen video means unread subtitles. Put both your console and this PC on cables to the router.
health.check.picture.name: PS5 picture
health.check.picture.noPicture: No video: the PS5 isn't linked
health.check.ps5.advice.asleep: Your PS5 is switched off or resting. Switch it on, or enable "Stay Connected to the Internet" among its rest mode options.
health.check.ps5.advice.loginPasscode: A login passcode is set on the second account. Remove it using the console.
health.check.ps5.advice.notFound: No reply from the PS5. Make sure it's on or resting, and shares this network.
health.check.ps5.advice.other: The link keeps breaking. Wire both devices.
health.check.ps5.advice.otherDevice: Another device is using Remote Play. Quit it there.
health.check.ps5.advice.pairing: The PS5 refused this PC. Pair once more using Set Up Again, found under Settings › About Nino.
health.check.ps5.advice.remotePlayOff: Remote Play is disabled. Enable it using the console's settings.
health.check.ps5.name: PS5 link
health.check.speed.advice.closeApps: Quit demanding apps on this PC.
health.check.speed.advice.freeEngine: Switch to the Free engine under Settings › Translation.
health.check.speed.name: Speed
health.check.tv.advice: The TV app isn't linked. Start it, and confirm the TV shares this network.
health.checks.hint.lastSession: Results from the previous session. Starting translation measures them again.
health.checks.hint.noData: Start translating and play for several minutes; Nino checks the connection during play.
health.details.privacy: If something's broken, give the zip to the person helping you. Inside: subtitles that were read, plus your console's name and home network address. Nothing like passwords, keys or account info.
health.recent.autoOff: Auto reports are off. Send these yourself using Report an Issue.
health.recent.autoOn: Nino reports these automatically (just a summary; never logs or subtitles). Nothing for you to do.
health.recent.title: Latest Issues
history.empty: Nothing here yet. Translated lines from this and past sessions will appear here.
history.subtitle: This computer keeps your %lld most recent translated lines.
home.card.engineFailed.hint: Under Settings › Translation, pick DeepL or the free Gemini.
home.card.engineFailed.title: Free translation won't launch here.
home.card.gpu.warning: The GPU isn't available, so free translation runs on the CPU.
home.card.model.title: First, the translation model needs downloading.
home.card.ocr.hint: If it's missing, Windows reads subtitles as the system's language and translations come out wrong. One install is enough, and Windows asks you first.
home.card.ocr.title: This computer can't yet recognize text in this game's language.
home.card.online.fallback: Free translation is being used in the meantime.
home.card.online.title: %@ isn't translating right now
home.card.unsupportedLanguage.title: This language isn't available with free translation yet.
home.overlay.failed: The subtitle window couldn't open. Translation keeps running, but subtitles won't appear in that window. Nino will try again next time it opens.
home.toast.translationStarted: Nino: Subtitle translation is on. Have fun playing!
home.toggle.description: Nino catches English subtitles from your PS5 and shows Turkish ones on the TV.
home.tv.idle: Plug in the cord to begin
overlay.adjust.hint: Drag it anywhere. Pull an edge to change its size.
overlay.error.message: Nino couldn't open its subtitle window on this screen. Translating continues, though this window stays empty. Next time it's opened, Nino tries once more.
pack.deleteDownloaded.hint: Packs you imported yourself are kept.
pack.import.error.formatRequired: The pack needs a format number.
pack.import.error.noLines: No valid lines were found in this file.
pack.import.error.notUtf8: The file isn't valid UTF-8 text.
pack.import.error.sameFile: That file is the pack already installed. Give the game another name.
pack.import.error.tooLarge: The file is too large (64 MB max).
pack.import.error.unsupportedType: This file type isn't supported. Use .json, .txt or .srt.
pack.import.replaceMessage: There's already a pack using this ID. Continuing will write over it.
pack.import.title: Add a Game Pack
pack.settings.description: Uses prepared Turkish translations for games that have them. English to Turkish only.
pack.settings.title: Game packs
packImport.installFailed: The game pack couldn't be installed.
packImport.noUsable: There are no usable translations in this file.
packImport.replace.message: There's already a pack installed with this ID. Continuing will write over it.
packImport.replace.title: Overwrite this pack?
packImport.sameLocation: The file is already where packs get installed. Give the game another title.
pool.settings.description: Sends English lines that aren't in any game pack, without personal data, and uses translations shared by other players.
pool.settings.offHint: When it's off, nothing is sent and waiting lines are deleted.
pool.settings.poolFirstHint: For some games Nino still asks the pool for translations, even when this is off.
pool.settings.title: Shared pool
psnLogin.error.badResponse: Sony's answer didn't make sense to Nino. Try signing in once more, and update Nino if it repeats.
psnLogin.error.network: Nino can't reach Sony's server for signing in. Make sure you're online and try signing in once more.
psnLogin.error.pageLoadFailed: The Sony sign-in page wouldn't open. Make sure you're online and try signing in once more.
psnLogin.error.rateLimited: Sony saw too many attempts. Give it roughly 15 minutes before signing in once more.
psnLogin.error.refused: Sony stopped the sign-in. Give it one minute; afterwards choose Sign in and use the second account.
psnLogin.error.server: Sony's server for signing in had a problem. Give it a few minutes and try signing in once more.
psnLogin.error.windowClosed: The window was closed too early. Press Sign in, then complete everything inside the window.
psnLogin.manualId.invalid: This account ID isn't right. Expect 12 base64 characters, for example AbCdEfGhIjk=.
psnLogin.manualId.label: Account ID
psnLogin.movedToBrowser: Inside Nino, Sony's page couldn't connect, so sign-in continues in your browser instead.
psnLogin.paste.noCode: No sign-in code in this address. It must begin with https://remoteplay.dl.playstation.net/remoteplay/redirect?code=
psnLogin.paste.placeholder: Paste the address from your browser
psnLogin.webView2Missing: Microsoft WebView2 is missing here, and Nino's login window depends on it. Install it using the page now open, then choose Sign in once more.
psnLogin.window.title: PlayStation Network
reading.gamePicker.title: What are you playing?
reading.ocrMissing: Windows has no text recognition for this game's language. Add it under Windows Settings › Time & language › Language & region.
reading.region.noText: This area has no readable text
reading.screen.noFrame: Nothing to capture: the PS5 hasn't sent a picture
reading.screen.noText: The screen has no readable text
reading.screen.reason.rateLimited: %@ hit its limit for this minute. Retry shortly.
reading.screen.reason.unexpected: An unexpected error occurred. Please retry.
report.drop: Add an image or a .txt file
report.dropHint: Drag it here or click to choose · up to 5 files
report.error.dailyLimit: That's a lot of reports for today. Try again tomorrow.
report.error.offline: The report didn't go through. Make sure you're online, then retry.
report.error.server: The report didn't go through. Give it a little while and retry.
report.error.tooLarge: This report is too big. Take out one file and send it again.
report.file.limit: That file didn't fit: up to 5 files, and no more than 3 of them images.
report.file.unreadable: That file couldn't be opened. Add an image or a .txt file.
report.footer: Your message, your files and the app's logs go to the developer. Keys and passwords are never included.
report.placeholder: Tell us what went wrong: the game, and what you expected to see.
report.thanks: Thank you! We got your report.
report.title: Report an Issue
settings.appearance.label: Appearance
settings.area.extraHint: Mark an area to translate, like a quest panel. In game, its shortcut (%@) reads and translates it one time, and you pick where the result goes. Nino doesn't need to be in front.
settings.area.freeAreaHint: In game, press %@: the PC freezes the picture and you drag across whatever you want translated, one time. Esc exits.
settings.area.keepReadingHint: While translating, Nino checks this area about every second. Results show with the subtitles, next to the source text, until that text changes.
settings.area.pauseHint: %@ stops or restarts live subtitle translation; handy while translating areas.
settings.area.preset.label: Area preset
settings.area.previewPlaceholder: The game picture shows up here once translation starts.
settings.area.shortcutsHint: The shortcuts are active only during translation, so other apps keep these keys. Num keys need Num Lock on. Edit them in the Keyboard shortcuts section.
settings.area.subtitleHint: On the picture, drag a box over the spot where the game puts its subtitles. Pull an edge to resize, or drag inside to move.
settings.area.translateScreenHint: In game, press %@: Nino translates all text on screen one time and places each translation on the TV where its text is. Press again to clear.
settings.connection.cardLayout.computer: Computer: the game fills the screen with sound and Nino draws the translation over it. Cable this PC to the TV or monitor.
settings.connection.cardLayout.tv: TV: the card passes the PS5 picture through to the TV, while Nino watches the card's feed and hands translations to Nino's TV app.
settings.connection.clickThroughHint: With this on, clicks reach the window behind it. %@ switches it off.
settings.connection.computerHint: Subtitles appear in their own window here on this computer, floating above the game (PS Remote Play / chiaki-ng).
settings.connection.connectionGuide.tool: Wiring the PS5, capture card and display, plus switching off HDCP.
settings.connection.hint.captureCard: PS5 into the capture card, card into this computer; no extra account required. On the console, switch off Enable HDCP (Settings › System › HDMI).
settings.connection.hint.ps5: Subtitles are shown by Nino's TV app.
settings.connection.hint.remotePlayWindo: Run PS Remote Play/chiaki-ng here. Nino reads its window and draws the translation over the game; no extra account required.
settings.connection.hint.xboxWindow: Start Remote play from your Xbox app, or from a browser (xbox.com/play). Afterwards Nino reads its window and draws the translation.
settings.home.livingRoom.description: Plug in the cable to switch the Turkish subtitles on.
settings.home.livingRoom.name: Living room
settings.home.title: Home screen
settings.home.toggle.description: Flip the glass switch to lower the TV and show the live line.
settings.home.toggle.name: Glass toggle
settings.language.nonTurkishHint: Packs and Nino's term list are Turkish only. For other languages, your chosen engine does the work (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, DeepL, a local model, or free translation). Filipino, Malay, Bengali, Urdu and Thai require AI translation on Windows; Gemini is free.
settings.obs.hint: Going live through a capture card? Add an OBS Browser source pointed at this address, sized 1920 × 1080. Subtitles then sit over the game, for you and for your viewers.
settings.obs.keepOpenHint: Leave this window open and visible while you stream. During translation it shows subtitles, even ones meant only for the TV.
settings.obs.networkAddressHint: If your app rejects localhost (for instance TikTok LIVE Studio), use this address instead; it points at this PC's network address:
settings.obs.otherComputerHint: OBS on a different computer? Replace localhost with this PC's network address. Subtitles only show in the overlay during translation.
settings.obs.streamWindowHint: No transparent browser source in your app (for instance TikTok LIVE Studio or Streamlabs)? Show the stream window, capture it as a window (its name is “%@”), and key out the background with Chroma key.
settings.packs.askGameHint: When no pack knows the game, Nino asks one time, two minutes into translating.
settings.packs.description: Prepared Turkish translations for certain games. Whenever a pack has the line, it appears right away, with no engine involved.
settings.packs.importInvalid: This translation file couldn't be added. Make sure the format and text encoding are right.
settings.packs.sharePool: Share the English lines Nino reads with the pool
settings.packs.sharePoolHint: Only English game text goes out, anonymously. It improves the Turkish translations everyone gets.
settings.packs.speakerNamesHint: The speaker's name is kept before the translated line (ARTHUR: …) and never translated.
settings.packs.turkishOnly: Packs only apply when you translate into Turkish.
settings.passcode.hint: Only needed when the second account uses a passcode to log in on the PS5. When the console asks, Nino enters it. Stored on this PC, encrypted.
settings.reset.confirmMessage: Nino forgets the PS5, the account and the TV link, then setup begins from the first step.
settings.reset.description: Set up the TV again: keeps the PS5 account and pairing, redoes just the TV link. Start fresh: forgets the PS5, the account and the TV link, and PSN sign-in starts over.
settings.shortcuts.busy: Another app has taken %@. It may fail while that app runs.
settings.shortcuts.error.altGr: Plenty of keyboards treat Ctrl+Alt as AltGr, which would stop you typing # or {. Pick Ctrl+Shift.
settings.shortcuts.error.needsModifier: Pair this key with Alt, Alt+Shift, or Ctrl+Shift, so typing elsewhere keeps working.
settings.shortcuts.error.reserved: This shortcut is already used by Windows.
settings.shortcuts.error.unsupported: That key isn't allowed in a shortcut.
settings.shortcuts.intro: Each action gets two shortcuts, so keyboards without a numpad work too. Click one and press new keys. Backspace clears; Esc cancels.
settings.shortcuts.workOnlyWhileTranslat: Shortcuts are active during translation only, with Nino in front or behind other windows.
settings.source.captureWindowHint: Start a game window or OBS projector and choose it here. Nino reads just that window, and won't switch to the full desktop if it closes.
settings.source.noWindows: Nothing usable to read. Start the game or OBS and refresh the list.
settings.source.notLinked: No PS5 linked so far. Sign in using the second account, then pair your console.
settings.source.ps5Hint: Nino reaches the PS5 through the second account, so Sony's own Remote Play app can't run alongside it.
settings.source.remotePlayApp.label: Remote Play program
settings.source.windowHint: Run PS Remote Play/chiaki-ng here and Nino reads just its window, with no second account. Choose the computer screen for subtitles.
settings.source.xboxLegacyFrameRateHint: On: one Xbox frame each 200 ms, lighter on the CPU. Off (default): each 66 ms, for quicker subtitles.
settings.source.xboxQualityHint: If the Xbox stream keeps dropping, pick 720p: it sends less data and the connection holds better. The stream restarts when you change this.
settings.subtitle.autoSize: Size TV text to fit the game
settings.subtitle.autoSizeHint: With this on, the TV matches text size to the original English line. Picking a size below switches it off.
settings.subtitle.background.label: Background
settings.subtitle.backgroundShape.label: Background shape
settings.subtitle.backgroundShapeHint: Push Background fully to Solid and the original English line is hidden entirely. An edge-to-edge strip hides the sides as well.
settings.subtitle.computerHint: Drag the subtitle window to move it on this computer. Begin with Move the Subtitle Window.
settings.subtitle.displayMode.label: Display mode
settings.subtitle.displayModeHint: Black PS5 picture in the TV app? Choose On top: the TV switches to its HDMI input for the console, with subtitles laid over it. When no picture ever comes, the app makes this switch for you.
settings.subtitle.font.label: Font
settings.subtitle.placement.label: Placement
settings.subtitle.placementFollowsHint: Each translation shows wherever the game puts its own line.
settings.subtitle.position.label: Where on screen
settings.subtitle.positionHint: With a set position, the remote's ▲ and ▼ buttons move the subtitle as well.
settings.subtitle.stackPrevious: Stack earlier lines during quick dialogue
settings.subtitle.stackPreviousHint: Off: a new line takes the old one's place. Requires TV app version 0.9.16 at least.
settings.subtitle.testLine: Here's a sample line. Is it visible over the game?
settings.subtitle.textColor.label: Text color
settings.subtitle.textSize.label: Text size
settings.subtitle.watermarkHint: Off hides just the little Nino logo in the lower-left corner of your TV.
settings.translation.cpuThreadsWarning: Most CPU threads go to translating; games may run slower.
settings.translation.deviceHint: Every computer can use CPU. GPU requires a supported NVIDIA card; picking it the first time downloads roughly 565 MB of NVIDIA CUDA files (roughly 790 MB once installed). When GPU fails, Nino falls back to CPU.
settings.translation.engine.local: Model on this PC (Ollama, LM Studio)
settings.translation.engineHint.claude: Claude by Anthropic keeps the mood of the game and leaves names untouched. Subtitles travel to Anthropic using your key; charges, if any, are billed by Anthropic. If Claude is unreachable, free translation fills in.
settings.translation.engineHint.deepl: Optional. A free DeepL key of your own makes lines read more naturally. Subtitles travel to DeepL; if it's unreachable, this computer's model fills in.
settings.translation.engineHint.free: Costs nothing. Nino's own model translates right here, and subtitles stay on this computer.
settings.translation.engineHint.gemini: Gemini by Google keeps the mood of the game and leaves names untouched. Subtitles travel to Google using your key; charges, if any, are billed by Google. If Gemini is unreachable, free translation fills in.
settings.translation.engineHint.local: Free and unlimited. A local AI model (via Ollama, or via LM Studio) translates, and subtitles stay on this computer. A faster computer means faster lines. If the model is unreachable, free translation fills in.
settings.translation.engineHint.openai: OpenAI's model keeps the mood of the game and leaves names untouched. Subtitles travel to OpenAI using your key; charges, if any, are billed by OpenAI. If OpenAI is unreachable, free translation fills in.
settings.translation.englishOnlyHint: Online engines only translate English games. Other game languages use the free translation.
settings.translation.fastDetection: Recheck a still subtitle area sooner
settings.translation.fastDetectionHint: When the area hasn't changed, look once more after 2 frames, not 20. More CPU use.
settings.translation.geminiLimit: Free keys allow only so many lines a minute. Beyond that, free translation handles the line.
settings.translation.geminiOffer: Nicer translations? A Gemini key costs nothing.
settings.translation.geminiPrivacy: Subtitles go to Google. On free keys, Google can use them for its products, and its staff may read them. Only game subtitles leave this PC.
settings.translation.gpuFallback: GPU unavailable; free translation is using the CPU.
settings.translation.localHint: Enter the model name just as your server lists it. For Ollama, start with ollama pull translategemma:4b (if the PC has 16 GB or more, prefer translategemma:12b). For Xiaomi MiLMMT: ollama pull hf.co/mradermacher/MiLMMT-46-4B-v1.0-GGUF:Q4_K_M. Run ollama list to see your models. For LM Studio, load the model and run its local server.
settings.translation.misreadWaitHint: GTA V test, mistranslations from misreads versus no delay: 0.2 sec 77%%, 0.4 sec 49%%, 0.6 sec 41%%, 0.8 sec 34%% (recommended), 1.0 sec 31%%.
settings.translation.noKeyHint: Enter a key to begin. Meanwhile, Nino uses free translation.
settings.translation.partialWaitHint: A line missing its final punctuation (like quest text with colored words) is given up to this long to be read completely. Small effect; 0.3 sec recommended.
settings.translation.result.aiKeyRejecte: %@ refused this key. Paste a fresh copy from the account page.
settings.translation.result.aiQuota: No credit left on your %@ account, or its limit is reached.
settings.translation.result.deeplQuota: Your DeepL allowance for the month is used up. This computer's model translates until it renews.
settings.translation.result.deeplRejecte: DeepL refused this key. Paste a fresh copy from your DeepL page.
settings.translation.result.deeplUnreach: DeepL is out of reach. Make sure you're online.
settings.translation.result.deeplUsage: Used so far this month: %1$@ characters of %2$@.
settings.translation.result.lmStudioNoMo: %@ isn't in LM Studio. Get the model and load it there, or correct the model name.
settings.translation.result.lmStudioUnre: LM Studio isn't responding: %@ is unreachable, or the model was too slow. Start LM Studio, load your model, and run the local server.
settings.translation.result.localBusy: The local server is occupied. Retry shortly.
settings.translation.result.localKeyReje: The local server refused the API key. Correct it, or clear it if no key is required.
settings.translation.result.localNoModel: The local server lacks %1$@. Get it using: ollama pull %1$@
settings.translation.result.localUnreach: The local server at %@ is unreachable, or the model was too slow. Verify the address and confirm the server is up.

settings.translation.waitsHint: These delays only affect badly read lines; most lines appear at once. Shorter delays show such lines faster but let more mistranslations slip by.
setup.better.description: Free translation runs offline but can feel stiff. Gemini from Google sounds far more natural, and a Google key costs nothing.
setup.better.deviceHint: Every computer can use CPU. GPU requires a supported NVIDIA card; picking it the first time downloads roughly 565 MB of NVIDIA CUDA files (roughly 790 MB once installed). When GPU fails, Nino falls back to CPU.
setup.better.geminiReady: Gemini is set up. From now on Gemini translates your subtitles.
setup.better.gpuFallback: GPU unavailable; free translation is using the CPU.
setup.better.limitHint: Free keys allow only so many lines a minute. Once that's reached, free translation handles the line.
setup.better.privacyHint: Subtitles go to Google. On free keys, Google can use them for its products, and its staff may read them. Only game subtitles leave this PC.
setup.better.step1: Press "Get My Free Key" and log in with Google.
setup.better.step2: Choose "Create API key", then copy what appears.
setup.better.step3: Paste it into the box below, then press "Save & Check".
setup.better.title: Nicer translations, free
setup.model.description: Translation happens right on this PC, offline. A one-time download of the model for English–Turkish (around 475 MB) is kept here.
setup.model.downloadFailed: Downloading stopped early. Make sure you're online and retry.
setup.model.title: Get the translation model
setup.msSignIn.description: Link Xbox using a device code from Microsoft, as Greenlight does. Your usual browser opens Microsoft's login page.
setup.msSignIn.statusFailed: Signing in didn't work. Feel free to retry.
setup.msSignIn.statusWaiting: Finish signing in, Nino is waiting…
setup.msSignIn.step1: 1. Your browser now shows microsoft.com/link, and the code is on your clipboard. No page? Use the link above.
setup.msSignIn.step2: 2. Enter the code there, log in with your Xbox Microsoft account, and approve.
setup.msSignIn.step3: 3. Return to Nino; it completes on its own.
setup.msSignIn.title: Link your Microsoft account
setup.ps5.connecting: Reaching your PS5. Allow as long as 30 seconds.
setup.ps5.description: Switch on your console and pick the second user. Go to Pair Device (Settings › System › Remote Play), then type the 8 digits it displays.
setup.ps5.notFound: Can't find a PS5. Check it's switched on and on this network, or type its IP address.
setup.ps5.pairFailed: Couldn't pair (%1$@). If this repeats, please send us %2$@
setup.psnAccount.captureWindowHint: Nino reads only the window chosen in Settings › Video source (a game window or OBS projector). You won't need another PSN account or capture app.
setup.psnAccount.captureWindowTitle: Capturing a game or OBS on this PC?
setup.psnAccount.description: Nino follows the game over Remote Play. Using your main account, your controller would get switched off; a separate account lets you keep playing normally.
setup.psnAccount.mainAccountHint: After switching the controller on, choose your MAIN user on the console. Never play as Nino's second account, since your controller then stops working in game.
setup.psnAccount.noRemotePlayApp: This computer has neither PS Remote Play nor chiaki-ng.
setup.psnAccount.remotePlayWindowHint: Nino reads subtitles off PS Remote Play/chiaki-ng running here. No extra account, no pairing. A TV can be added afterwards.
setup.psnAccount.remotePlayWindowTitle: Only one account? Read Remote Play's window
setup.psnAccount.step1: Make a free playstation.com account using another email address.
setup.psnAccount.step2: On the PS5, pick Add User and log in one time as the new account.
setup.psnAccount.step3: Still signed in as that user, set Enable Remote Play to On, found at Settings › System › Remote Play.
setup.psnAccount.step4: Go back to your usual user. This is a one-time step.
setup.psnAccount.title: An extra PSN account
setup.psnSignIn.browserSteps: In the new browser window, log in as your second account. Afterwards it stops on a page at remoteplay.dl.playstation.net showing just "redirect". Copy the full URL from the address bar and return here. Nino notices the copied URL; otherwise paste it into the box below, then press Save.
setup.psnSignIn.description: Sony receives your password directly. Nino keeps just your account ID.
setup.psnSignIn.invalidId: This account ID isn't right. Expect 12 base64 characters, for example AbCdEfGhIjk=.
setup.psnSignIn.manualHint: Sony's login page blocked by your provider? Type the PSN ID of your second account, a 12-character base64 value (like AbCdEfGhIjk=).
setup.psnSignIn.title: Log in as the second account
setup.psnSignIn.webView2Missing: Microsoft WebView2 is missing here, and Nino's login window depends on it. Install it using the page now open, then choose Sign in once more.
setup.sidebar.title: Setup
setup.try.descriptionScreen: A sample line will pop up along the bottom of this PC's display.
setup.try.descriptionTv: A sample line goes to your TV and should pop up along the bottom, over the game.
setup.try.notSeenScreen: Nothing? Send another. It stays at the bottom for several seconds.
setup.try.notSeenTv: Nothing? Reopen Nino on your TV and reconnect.
setup.try.poolHint: Nino shares the English lines it reads with a common pool, without your identity, so translations improve for all. You can disable this in Settings.
setup.try.questionTv: Is it showing on the TV?
setup.try.title: Quick test
setup.tv.androidTvHint: Android TV sets by brands such as Philips, Grundig, Beko, Arçelik or Vestel.
setup.tv.description: Switch the TV on. Press Connect and the TV asks one time for permission; accept it with your remote. No Nino TV app yet? This screen walks you through installing it.
setup.tv.firewallHint: TV not connecting? The firewall could be stopping Nino. Give Nino permission under Settings › Windows Firewall. Also mark this network "Private" in Windows.
setup.tv.manualInstallText: Follow the guide to get Nino onto this TV, then start it. It locates this computer on its own.
setup.tv.noTvHint: A separate window shows the subtitles above your game. A TV can be added afterwards.
setup.tv.noTvTitle: Without a TV? Use this PC's display
setup.tv.title: Link a TV
setup.tv.waitSamsung: Choose Allow with your remote once the TV shows its prompt. Nino gives it 60 seconds.
setup.welcome.descriptionPs5: Nino picks up English subtitles from PS5 and Xbox games and lays a Turkish translation over your gameplay on the TV. Play on the TV as always, with your controller.
setup.welcome.descriptionXbox: Xbox is a beta feature. Nino reads subtitles from the video of your game and shows them translated on a TV or this PC. Play as always, with your controller.
setup.welcome.needLgTv: An LG TV running Nino's TV app
setup.welcome.needPs5: A PS5 sharing this PC's network
setup.welcome.needSecondAccount: A second, free PlayStation Network account
setup.welcome.shortcutCaptureCardTooltip: Works without a second account: Nino takes the video from your card and displays it translated.
setup.welcome.shortcutRemotePlay: I use PS Remote Play on this PC
setup.welcome.shortcutXboxTooltip: Begin remote play from xbox.com/play, Greenlight, or the Xbox app. Nino then reads it and sends your TV the translation.
setup.welcome.shortcutsHint: Works with no TV and no second account: Nino reads Remote Play's window and draws the translation over the game.
setup.welcome.title: Hello, this is Nino
setup.welcome.xboxRequirements: Requirements: an Xbox at home sharing this network, your Microsoft account, plus a TV or PC for the subtitles. The Xbox must allow remote play.
setup.xbox.description: Switch the Xbox on, keep it on this PC's network, and enable remote play in its settings.
setup.xbox.noneFound: No home console is linked to this Microsoft account.
setup.xbox.title: Pick your Xbox at home

tv.pair.error.samsungTimeout: Nobody accepted the TV's prompt within 60 seconds. No prompt shown? Go to the TV's home screen and press Connect once more. If Nino was blocked earlier, allow it under Settings › General › External Device Manager › Device Connection Manager › Device List.

tvApp.android.menuHint: Brands name these menus differently. Skip this step if Nino is installed already.
tvApp.android.searching: Searching the network for your TV…
tvApp.android.step1: 1. Go to Settings › Device Preferences › About (on Google TV: Settings › System › About).
tvApp.android.step2: 2. Select Build and press OK 7 times, until the TV confirms developer mode.
tvApp.android.step3: 3. Under Device Preferences (Google TV: System) › Developer options, switch on USB debugging, plus Network debugging if it's listed.
tvApp.detail.anynet: Does the TV keep leaving Nino for HDMI 1 or some other input? Turn Anynet+ (HDMI-CEC) off, plus Auto Source Switching, under Settings › All Settings › Connection › External Device Manager.
tvApp.detail.approveOnTv: Tick the option to always allow this computer, then pick Allow, and installation continues on its own.
tvApp.detail.lgAutoExtend: Whenever you use Nino, it renews Developer Mode for you.
tvApp.detail.lgHoursLeft: Developer Mode ends in %lld hours. Whenever you use Nino, it renews it for you.
tvApp.detail.samsungNoAccount: No account yet? Sign up free on that page. Allow the browser to reach local devices if it asks.
tvApp.detail.samsungSignIn: To sign Nino for this TV, Samsung needs a Samsung account, which is free.
tvApp.detail.samsungSignInNoAccount: No account yet? Sign up free on that page. Allow the browser to reach local devices if it asks.
tvApp.detail.samsungSourceSwitch: Does the TV keep leaving Nino for HDMI 1 or some other input? Turn Anynet+ (HDMI-CEC) off, plus Auto Source Switching.
tvApp.error.certMismatch: The TV has an earlier Nino signed with another certificate. Uninstall that copy, then retry.
tvApp.error.certNotIssued: No certificate came from Samsung. Retry shortly.
tvApp.error.certRejected: The signing certificate was refused by the TV. Retry and Nino will request a fresh one.
tvApp.error.connectionLost: Lost the TV in the middle of installing. Please retry.
tvApp.error.hostPcMismatch: On the TV, Host PC IP holds %1$@, but this computer uses %2$@. Inside Developer Mode, change Host PC IP into %2$@, then fully restart the TV (keep the power button pressed for roughly 2 seconds).
tvApp.error.installFailed: Nino couldn't be installed on the TV. Retry; if that fails too, please send us the error shown below.
tvApp.error.keyRejected: The saved key was refused by the TV. Enter the passphrase once more.
tvApp.error.keyServerOff: Key Server isn't on. Open Developer Mode on your TV, switch Key Server on, then retry.
tvApp.error.noSpace: Not enough free storage on the TV. Uninstall an unused app and retry.
tvApp.error.notApproved: The TV didn't permit debugging. Retry and choose Allow when it asks.
tvApp.error.packageBlocked: Leftover data on the TV prevents installing. Uninstall the TV app, reboot the TV, and retry.
tvApp.error.signInFailed: The Samsung sign-in wasn't finished. Retry and complete it in your browser.
tvApp.error.tooOld: Nino's TV app needs newer TV software than this TV has.
tvApp.error.toolMissing: OpenSSH Client for Windows isn't installed. Add it under Settings › System › Optional features, then retry.
tvApp.error.tvClockBehind: The TV's time is wrong. Fix its clock and date, then retry.
tvApp.error.unreachableSamsung: The TV refused this computer. Make sure Developer Mode is enabled and Host PC IP matches this computer, then reboot the TV.
tvApp.error.wrongPassphrase: That passphrase is incorrect. Enter the one shown in Developer Mode.
tvApp.lg.step1: 1. Make a free account on webostv.developer.lge.com.
tvApp.lg.step2: 2. On your TV, open LG Content Store, get Developer Mode, then log in.
tvApp.lg.step3: 3. Switch Dev Mode Status on. After the TV reboots, this screen moves on automatically.
tvApp.passphrase.hint: Start Developer Mode on your TV, switch Key Server on, and keep it visible. Enter the Passphrase it displays.
tvApp.problem.restartSamsung: For a full Samsung restart, keep the remote's power button pressed for roughly 2 seconds, till the screen goes off; a quick press just sends it to standby.
tvApp.problem.serverMaintenance: Seeing “Server under maintenance” on the TV? Give it several minutes, then retry.
tvApp.reopen.hint: No sign-in window? Your browser might have stopped the pop-up. Allow it using the address bar icon, then press "Reopen Page".
tvApp.samsung.cecTip: TV keeps changing inputs? Turn Anynet+ (HDMI-CEC) off, plus Auto Source Switching, under Settings › All Settings › Connection › External Device Manager.
tvApp.samsung.signInLater: Next comes a one-time login using a Samsung account (free), which Samsung uses for signing the app.
tvApp.samsung.signInNote: After that comes a one-time login using a Samsung account (free), which Samsung uses for signing the app.
tvApp.samsung.step1: 1. Go to Apps on the TV. If App Settings is listed at the end of that page, select it.
tvApp.samsung.step2: 2. Enter 1 2 3 4 5. No number keys on the remote? Press 123 and pick them on screen. The fifth digit opens Developer Mode.
tvApp.samsung.step3: 3. Switch Developer mode to On and put this PC's IP in Host PC IP: %@. Skip leading zeros in each part (write 1 instead of 001), then press OK. Address field locked? Press 123 first.
tvApp.samsung.step4: 4. Reboot the TV (keep the power button pressed until you see Samsung's logo, or unplug it for one minute). This screen moves on automatically.
tvApp.signIn.popupHint: No sign-in window? Your browser might have stopped the pop-up. Allow it using the address bar icon, then press Reopen Page.

wizard.psn.error.network: Sony is out of reach. Make sure you're online.
wizard.psn.error.pageFailed: The Sony sign-in page wouldn't open. Make sure you're online.
wizard.psn.error.rateLimited: Too many tries. Give it roughly 15 minutes, then retry.
wizard.psn.error.rejected: Sony stopped the sign-in. After one minute, log in once more as the second account.
wizard.psn.error.server: Sony's server for signing in had a problem. Retry shortly.
wizard.psn.error.windowClosed: The window was closed too early. Press Sign In, then complete everything inside the window.
wizard.xbox.error.signInNotFinished: Signing in to Microsoft is still incomplete.
wizard.xbox.error.unavailable: This build can't stream from Xbox.
firewall.settings.title: Firewall
firewall.settings.ready: Nino can use Private networks for local connections.
firewall.settings.configure: Let the TV and PS5 reach Nino on a Private network that you trust.
ai.model.better: Higher quality, takes a bit longer
about.telemetry: Nino sends anonymous error and speed statistics so it can be fixed and made faster. No subtitles, screenshots, names or addresses are ever sent.
home.hint.connectTVFirst: Set up your TV, then plug it in
home.keySuggestion.title: Add a translation key for this game
home.keySuggestion.detail: Nino has no ready pack for %@. With a key, translation reads far more naturally.
settings.title: Settings
settings.ask.hint: Ask Nino anything about connecting, translation or settings.
settings.updates.auto: Nino finds new releases by itself and sets them up quietly; you get the new release on your next launch.
settings.updates.failed: Couldn't look for updates. Make sure you're online.
settings.updates.installHint: Nino fetches the update, sets it up and restarts itself. All your settings are kept.
settings.reset.hint: Redo from the TV step: Nino keeps the PS5, account and pairing, and only sets up the TV link once more. Reset everything: Nino forgets the PS5, the account and the TV link, and you log in to PSN from scratch.
settings.reset.fromTV: Redo setup starting at the TV
settings.connection.cardTVHint: TV: the card passes the PS5 image on to the TV over its HDMI output. Nino watches the card's feed and delivers the translation to Nino's TV app.
settings.connection.cardComputerHint: Computer: Nino fills the whole screen with the game, sound included, and lays the translation over it. Hook this computer up to a television or a monitor.
settings.connection.guideHelp: Step-by-step wiring for PS5, capture card and display, plus turning HDCP off.
settings.connection.remotePlayHint: Use PS Remote Play / chiaki-ng to play here. Nino watches that window and lays the translation over the game. A second account isn't required.
settings.connection.ps5Hint: Subtitles show up on your television, within Nino's TV app.
settings.tv.none: No TV is set up yet.
settings.tv.overlayHint: Switch on when Nino shows a black screen instead of the game; translations are then drawn over the HDMI feed.
settings.style.title: Subtitle look
settings.style.autoSize: Match the size of in-game subtitles
settings.style.autoSizeHint: With auto size on, this makes the size found from the game bigger or smaller.
settings.style.speaker: Show the speaker's name
settings.style.speakerHint: Shows the speaker's name before the translation (ARTHUR: …). Names stay untranslated.
settings.library.title: Nino Game Translator Library Is On
settings.library.detail: These games are translated from the library:
settings.translation.englishOnly: Online engines only translate English games. Other game languages use the free translation.
settings.api.title: API keys
settings.api.message: To translate subtitles in other games, you need an API key (no server keeps it, and it is shared with no one).
settings.key.getDeepL: Get a DeepL API key for free
settings.deepl.badKey: DeepL rejected the key. Paste it once more from the account page on DeepL's site.
settings.deepl.limit: You've reached DeepL's monthly allowance. Until it refreshes, the model installed here on your computer translates.
settings.deepl.unreachable: DeepL didn't respond. Make sure you're online.
settings.deepl.usage: This month you've used %1$@ characters out of %2$@.
settings.engine.badKey: %@ rejected the key. Paste it once more from the account page on its site.
settings.engine.quota: Your %@ account is out of credit or has hit its limit.
settings.engine.model: %@ declined the request. Try the other model instead, or retry in a little while.
settings.engine.unreachable: %@ didn't respond. Make sure you're online.
settings.engine.local.badKey: Your local server rejected the API key. Double-check it, or delete it if that server doesn't use keys.
settings.engine.local.busy: Your local server is busy. Give it a moment and retry.
settings.engine.local.missing: The model %1$@ isn't on your local server yet. Get it with: ollama pull %1$@
settings.engine.local.missingLMStudio: LM Studio has no model called %@. Get it inside LM Studio and load it, or make sure the name is spelled right.
settings.engine.local.ollamaDown: Ollama isn't responding: nothing answered at %1$@, or the model was too slow. Launch Ollama and fetch the model with: ollama pull %2$@
settings.engine.local.lmStudioDown: LM Studio isn't responding: nothing answered at %@, or the model was too slow. Launch LM Studio, pick the model so it's loaded, then turn on its server.
settings.engine.local.otherDown: Nothing answered at %@, or the model was too slow. Make sure the address is right and your model server is up.
settings.local.badAddress: This address isn't valid. For example: %@
settings.local.nameHint: Using LM Studio or a different model? Enter its name exactly the way your server lists it. With LM Studio, load that model first, then turn on its server.
settings.packs.hint: Turkish translations prepared ahead of time for certain games. Lines that a pack covers show up instantly and skip the translation engine.
settings.packs.share: Share the English lines Nino reads with the common pool
settings.packs.shareHint: Nino shares just the English lines from the game, never your name. That way everyone ends up with better Turkish.
settings.obs.noLocalhost: Streaming software that won't take localhost, like TikTok LIVE Studio? Swap in your computer's local IP with this address:
settings.obs.streamHint: Does your streaming software lack a see-through browser source (as with TikTok LIVE Studio or Streamlabs)? Bring up the stream window, then use window capture to grab it (look for Nino Stream) and key out the backdrop using Chroma key.
settings.obs.keepOpen: Leave this window open and unblocked during your stream. Subtitles keep appearing in it while you translate, even if your setup sends them only to the TV.
home.gameRoom.question: What should your game room be called?
settings.gameRoom.name: Room name
